name: provenrail
description: Undo, a stop switch, phone approvals and a delete policy for coding agents, enforced in the tool hook.

plugins.name: provenrail-guard
plugins.description: Undo for coding agents, including what a shell command did, plus a stop switch, a loop breaker, a warning when two sessions edit one file, phone approvals, and rules that refuse destructive commands. Deterministic and offline, and it runs in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK and CI.
